name: n8tray
description: N8 Tray: one tray for Windows, macOS and Linux that hosts independent local apps through an open contract.

scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && node scripts/check-text.mjs
scripts.check:no-app: cargo fmt --all --check && node scripts/check-text.mjs && cargo clippy --workspace --exclude n8tray --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --exclude n8tray --locked && cargo build --workspace --exclude n8tray --locked
